description: Alpine Linux is a Linux distribution designed to be small, simple and secure.
notes:
The Kasm Alpine 3.23 Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Alpine 3.23 but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.
